recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future Permission.rule.data.resourceType changes should be made in HL7/data-access-policies unless Permission is reintroduced as an active core resource.
issue_request: FHIR-51070 was an Applied Security WG change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for Permission rules to identify a FHIR resource type directly rather than using Reference.type. The approved resolution was to add a resourceType element to Permission.rule.data.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3614 merged on 2025-08-25 while Permission was still an active core resource. Its source commit fa24efed513cb3bd1f4f517940724fbe299df79d added Permission.rule.data.resourceType as a 0..* Coding element with an extensible binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/resource-types in source/permission/structuredefinition-Permission.xml.
additional_context: Later core commit 0e2a8a7f839d5e1a43787523daccf07d958362f3 removed source/permission and the active fhir.ini Permission entries, and current core pages link Permission to https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/data-access-policies/StructureDefinition-Permission.html. The current HL7/data-access-policies source at input/resources/permission/StructureDefinition-Permission.xml already contains Permission.rule.data.resourceType.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit because current FHIR core no longer owns the Permission resource source and reintroducing source/permission would be out of build scope.

related_jiras.note: Same Permission agenda neighborhood, but it was retracted/no-change and does not change this applied resourceType decision.
Shared HL7/fhir PR #3614, but it concerns Provenance examples rather than Permission and was not decided here.
